name: What are the benefits of building an ADU on my property?
description: Benefits of an ADU include increased property value, potential rental income, flexible living space for family, and a dedicated workspace.

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building an ADU on my property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an ADU offers several benefits, including increasing property value and providing flexible space. It can generate rental income, offer housing for aging parents or adult children, or serve as a dedicated workspace. ADUs contribute to housing density without requiring new land development, aligning with sustainable living principles and offering long-term financial and lifestyle advantages.
